note: Edit this file to add new sprites; the app pulls it from GitHub on launch. 'variants' overrides the season default, 'extra' adds to it, 'how' and 'vadded' are keyed by variant type.

Cheat Master.effect: Every input counts as correct when entering Cheat Codes

sprites.name: Bush
sprites.ability: Spawns a bush on you over time; at max level you also get one per elimination.

how.Cheat Master: Lobby code GatherAndCraft (after the Ziggy Story quests)
